text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while September payrolls came in at only 29,000 jobs — this combination of tightening into a weakening labor market raises the risk of a policy mistake that tips the economy into recession, so be cautious about adding new risk right now.
RGTI is down 54% with the worst relative strength in your portfolio at -77, revenue is shrinking 34%, insiders are selling, and short interest is 20% — the thesis is broken, sell and move on.
QBTS is down 52% with negative earnings, 21% short interest, and insiders selling — there's no fundamental support here, exit this position to stop the bleeding.
BMNR is down nearly 59% from its high with three consecutive earnings misses and a relative strength of -60 — trim what's left to limit further damage unless you have a very specific reason to hold.

MSTR is a leveraged Bitcoin bet that's dropped 52% from its highs with -56 relative strength — into a rising rate environment this kind of speculative leverage works against you, so reduce your exposure.
Adobe at 8.5x earnings with a 10.7% free cash flow yield and a bullish MACD turn is genuinely cheap for a dominant software company — this is a good spot to add a small amount on strength.
Visa is at its 52-week high with bullish momentum turning on — this wide-moat payments giant tends to hold up well even in uncertain macro environments, making it a reasonable add.
